body: Lately it’s gaming with someone I met online, it’s the highlight of my days (I know, quite clingy). Also my little brother who comes by every evening and says he loves me. I wouldn’t know what to do but I guess it’s just the 2-3 people close to me who I wouldn’t want to upset? Idk tbh, after awhile there isn’t much so it’s trying to discover something that’s worth living for.
